{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "0xB10C",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; questioned whether default configs without overriding listen/discover actually self-advertise"
    },
    {
      "login": "naiyoma",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK, tested; suggested early check for proxy, code comment, and unit test"
    },
    {
      "login": "mzumsande",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; asked whether transparent torification accounts for exit node propagation"
    },
    {
      "login": "sedited",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "asked for PR status regarding unaddressed comments"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:4808171259",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Are we sure this is being used like this, since with just -proxy set we would not be listening or self-announcing?",
      "quote": "Hm are we sure this is being used like this? With just `-proxy` set, we wouldn't be listening and not self-announcing.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained users often override listen=1 and discover=1, or use onion=127.0.0.1:9050",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:4841808402"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:4841808402",
      "status_by_quote": "good point. it's either this or people using `onion=127.0.0.1:9050`."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3560920468",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "style",
      "text": "Add a comment explaining why there is a proxy check in GetLocalAddrForPeer",
      "quote": "Maybe add a comment? to explain a bit on why there's a proxy check here",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "added comment in latest push",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4009996438"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4009996438",
      "status_by_quote": "done both in the latest push. thanks!"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3595004116",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Check whether an outbound connection is proxied before IsPeerAddrLocalGood to avoid unnecessary checks",
      "quote": "An alternative approach would be to check whether an outbound connection is proxied before we even check if `IsPeerAddrLocalGood()`",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied noting impact on tor exits running nodes and added release note suggestion",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3993164388"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3993164388",
      "status_by_quote": "I don't think this use case would work with this patch. ex: tor exits who are also running bitcoin nodes."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3595747690",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Add a unit test in net_tests.cpp using SetProxy() to verify peer's reported address is not relayed",
      "quote": "I think its possible to test this in `net_tests.cpp` similar to `get_local_addr_for_peer_port` but using `SetProxy()`",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "test added in push",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4009996438"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4009996438",
      "status_by_quote": "done both in the latest push. thanks!"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4789341836",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Could transparent torification (e.g. Whonix) where defaults are not changed account for exit nodes being relayed, making the fix incomplete?",
      "quote": "Maybe it could also due to transparent torification where users do not change any defaults but the traffic is rerouted via tor externally, e.g. by an OS such as Whonix? In that case, the fix might not solve the problem completely.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author agreed that transparent torification won't be helped, but the patch still helps when users override defaults",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5640343652"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5640343652",
      "status_by_quote": "good point! I don't think we have a way to know unless we see it in action in the P2P network and this patch obviously won't work for systems running transparent torrification. but we can try to reduce it from core's end when people override defaults."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:4807919033",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "it makes sense to me to not advertise an address we know we can't be reached on",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "c:4938015789",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "It makes sense not to advertise these addresses, as they are not useful",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "tested",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4789341836",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Brought claims up to date across all comments and reviews under current schema. Added questions from 0xB10C and mzumsande, and suggestions from naiyoma (tests and code comments addressed in push).",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "review of the latest push which added unit test, comments, and release notes",
      "id": "c:5673229441"
    }
  ]
}
